  - type: lead
    text: An example tool released version 2 this week. This file is a fixture for the layout check, not real news.
  - type: text
    text: |-
      The release changes how the tool stores its settings. They move from one file in the home folder to a file in each project. The old file is still read, but it is no longer written. A warning tells you when the old file is the one in use.

      The second change is speed. The release notes say start-up is faster, without giving a number. I have not measured it, so I cannot say by how much.

      The third change is the command line. Two commands were renamed, and the old names still work for now. The notes say they will be removed in a later version, without a date.

      The fourth change is the plugin interface. Plugins written for version 1 load, but they print a warning. The notes list three functions that changed shape.

      The last change is the licence, which stays the same. Nothing in the notes says the price changes either.
